question: When baseline Combined and Depth are held fixed, do the non-exact Vector payloads retained by B52-D2 materially change a frozen Blender 5.2 Vector Blur result, and can magnitude-weighted error localization replace D3's exact nonzero-support count as a falsifiable proposal for a future holdout?
designClass: known-input Blender compositor task-semantics derivation with zero new Cycles sampling
parentDisclosure: All B52-D2 and B52-D3 measurements were observed before this derivation. B52-D4 is exploratory/derivational, creates new compositor outputs from retained EXRs, and may only propose a Vector task contract for a later fresh-seed holdout.

claims: Vector contains four components representing two screen-space motion vectors based on next and previous frames.
The Vector pass is intended for the Vector Blur node.
Vector Blur consumes Combined Image, Vector Speed and Depth.
Samples is a quality factor and Shutter is exposure duration.
The 2D pass cannot recover hidden or off-camera 3D information and may produce artifacts.
The compositor tree is an independent data block assigned through Scene.compositing_node_group.
Node options moved to identifier-addressed input sockets.
Group Output replaces the removed Composite node.
Scene.compositing_node_group is the Blender 5.2 compositor node tree binding.
Scene.use_nodes is deprecated and has no effect.

isolation.image: always the variant's PROD_T010_M0_R1 Combined pass
isolation.depth: always the variant's PROD_T010_M0_R1 Depth pass
isolation.speed: the cell profile's repeat-1 Vector pass; baseline cells use PROD_T010_M0_R1

renderShell.sceneContent: fresh empty scene with one generated camera; no source blend is opened
renderShell.interpretation: bpy.ops.render.render is used only to evaluate the compositor and write its Group Output; it is counted as a Blender render call but not as a Cycles scene-sampling render

repeatContract.comparison: decoded float32 RGBA arrays from the two fresh-process outputs of each profile × variant cell
repeatContract.required: shape, finite mask and every decoded channel are exact
repeatContract.containerNonIdentityInterpretation: metadata or container variation is recorded but cannot fail decoded repeat identity

baselineEffectGate.comparison: baseline Vector Blur output versus the same baseline Combined input
baselineEffectGate.failureMeaning: the chosen compositor task is non-informative for the retained scenes

influenceRegion.boundarySeeds: reuse the exact D3 baseline Cryptomatte boundary seeds
influenceRegion.baselineMotionMagnitude: per-pixel maximum of Euclidean norm(X,Y) and Euclidean norm(Z,W) from baseline Vector
influenceRegion.radiusFormulaPixels: ceil(maximum finite baseline motion magnitude * Shutter) + 1
influenceRegion.radiusOverflow: INVALID because a larger unregistered influence domain would be required

pairing.directionNonClaim: Neither pair is labeled previous or next; Blender Vector Blur consumes the full four-channel socket.

vectorMagnitudeTask.perPixelError: maximum of candidate-baseline Euclidean endpoint error for pairA and pairB
vectorMagnitudeTask.energy: sum of squared per-pixel error in float64 accumulation
vectorMagnitudeTask.zeroEnergyConvention: influenceRegionEnergyFraction = 1 when total energy is exactly zero

blurOutputTask.comparison: candidate-speed compositor output versus baseline-speed compositor output with baseline Combined and Depth held identical
blurOutputTask.rgbPerPixelError: maximum absolute error across scene-linear RGB
blurOutputTask.energy: sum of squared rgbPerPixelError in float64 accumulation
blurOutputTask.thresholdRationale: The 95% localization rule carries D3's preregistered fraction into an energy domain. RGB gates freeze one code value maximum, sub-code p99 and quarter-sub-code RMSE before compositor outputs exist. They are engineering thresholds, not human visibility thresholds.

diagnostics.sidecar: one canonical JSON file per PNG binding map kind, source/output identities, mapping, decoded-value SHA-256 and PNG SHA-256

decisionRule.vectorTaskTolerableProfile: the profile passes every blurOutputTask derivation classifier on both variants and both output repeats are decoded exact
decisionRule.promotionBoundary: a tolerable profile is only a proposed Vector contract; it cannot become a B52-D2 production candidate, override D3 Normal/Crypto failures, or bypass INTERIOR beauty

nonClaims: correct assignment of previous versus next Vector channel pair
freedom from Vector Blur's documented 2D occlusion and off-camera artifacts
candidate Combined or candidate Depth quality
